nodes.label: SYSTEM.md: How GLUE Works Now
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for GLUE's current architecture, the five pieces (Website, GLUE folder, GLUE Home, GLUE Cloud), profiles, collections, analysis, and the website layout.

nodes.label: GLUE's Five Pieces
nodes.rationale: Website (Svelte 5 + TypeScript on GitHub Pages), GLUE folder (JSON files, no database), GLUE Home (Tauri 2 tray app), GLUE Cloud (optional Cloudflare Worker with D1 and Durable Object), together making one system.

nodes.label: GLUE Folder: JSON Store
nodes.rationale: The user's data: JSON files for profiles, collections, tracks, analysis, lists, sources, events, and duplicates. No database. Handles are kept in IndexedDB. Caches stay in browser and GLUE Home, not in the folder.

nodes.label: Profile: Artist Alias
nodes.rationale: An artist alias with id, name, colour, BPM range. The account keeps the list when signed in. A GLUE folder has one library that every alias uses.

nodes.label: Collection: Music Folders, Songs, Playlists
nodes.rationale: A collection holds music folders, DJ libraries, songs, playlists, analyses, and events. Shared form syncs to GLUE Cloud. One row per song (best copy), one id per computer.

nodes.label: GLUE Home: Tauri 2 Tray App
nodes.rationale: GLUE Home is the computer's disk and engine when it runs. It has a local link on 127.0.0.1:47400-47409, an engine in Rust that applies edits and analyses, and WebRTC connections to other devices.

nodes.label: Analysis: Verdict, BPM, Key, Quality
nodes.rationale: Summary (verdict and tier, bandwidth, bit depth, BPM, key), full details, fingerprint, mini spectrogram, and waveform. Runs natively in GLUE Home (Rust) or in browser workers. Hi-res judged by ultrasonic content past 24 kHz.

nodes.label: GLUE Cloud: Cloudflare Worker and D1
nodes.rationale: Optional account service on Cloudflare. Holds accounts, devices, profiles, collections (shared form only, never music). Signaling Durable Object for presence and WebRTC signals.

nodes.label: Incoming Folder: TO BE SORTED
nodes.rationale: A hidden root (INCOMING_ROOT) where songs sent to this computer land. Shown as 'TO BE SORTED' in the library. Songs can be moved to a music folder.

nodes.label: Duplicates: Three Tiers
nodes.rationale: Found by fingerprints (same recording) and artist+title (probable). Only best copy shown and used. User can mark 'not a duplicate' or 'duplicates' manually.

nodes.label: Quality Verdicts: Lossless, Lossy, Hi-Res
nodes.rationale: Hi-res judged by ultrasonic content past 24 kHz. Steep top end with content above following music = lossless. A rule change bumps VERDICT_VERSION.
